conditions.description: Pin the immutable Starlight #103 human-review evidence bundle.

notes: Template only, owned by issue #103. This is the single authoritative redistribution decision record consumed by both promotion and licensing checks. Keep candidate_sha256, inventory_sha256, review_bundle_sha256, and the review-bundle-v1 condition pinned to the same frozen evidence unless a new review bundle is deliberately published. Additional approved_with_conditions entries must be structured machine-verifiable conditions; free-text conditions block automatic promotion. Do not fill reviewer_name/reviewer_role/reviewed_at_utc or change decision away from pending outside the #103 human process. Licensing evidence updated for Hipparcos-2, Tycho-2, XHIP, CK04, SVO and CALSPEC without modifying scientific dataset bytes. Unknown upstream grants are not invented; #103 human approval still required. Tycho-2 source license newly verified via the official CDS I/259 catalogue page (CC BY-NC 3.0 IGO); XHIP source redistribution, SVO original curve, and final map #103 approval remain pending. Hipparcos-2 public availability and required citations were confirmed by Floor van Leeuwen in correspondence supplied by the maintainer (reported 2026-10-14); the email does not expressly grant commercial/downstream derived-map redistribution or name an I/311 source-specific licence. SVO/FPS team email supplied by maintainer (reported 2026-10-08, signed Enrique) states that informing NSB users and giving the exact FPS/Bessell acknowledgement and four references is sufficient on their part for calculations; this is not blanket permission to reproduce the original SVO curve. Exact notice wording is in ATTRIBUTION.md and package notices. Human derived-map authorization remains pending.
